texts.title: Routing
texts.use_case: A support conversation: which team takes it, how fast, and whether the customer wants money back.

thread.text: Every page of our reporting dashboard has returned a 502 error since 8am. Our team of 120 cannot work, and we present these reports to our board at 2pm today.
I'm sorry for the disruption. I can add a service credit to your account while engineering investigates.
I don't want a credit. I want the dashboard working before 2pm.

question.instructions: What is this customer conversation primarily about?

criteria.account: Login, plan changes, profile or access management.
criteria.billing: A charge, invoice, subscription or payment problem.
criteria.delivery: Shipping, fulfilment or delivery of a physical item.
criteria.refund: The customer is explicitly asking for money back.
criteria.technical: The product or service is not working as expected.

criteria: No time pressure; can wait indefinitely.
Routine; handle within the normal queue.
Elevated; should be handled within the same week.
Critical; requires action within the same day.

question.instructions: The customer is explicitly asking for money back.

texts.title: Smart if-statement
texts.use_case: A vendor invoice with its purchase order and delivery: pay it, or not?

question.instructions: How should this vendor invoice be dispositioned?

criteria.approve: Matches the order and delivery; approve for payment.
criteria.hold: Something needs confirming before payment; hold pending clarification.
criteria.manual_review: A human in finance must review the discrepancy.
criteria.reject: Should not be paid: duplicate, unauthorised or materially wrong.

question.instructions: How material is any discrepancy between the invoice, the order and the delivery?
criteria: Trivial: rounding or a cosmetic difference.
Moderate: a real difference worth confirming.
Material: a large or unexplained difference.

question.instructions: This invoice appears to duplicate an invoice already submitted.

texts.title: Guardrail
texts.use_case: An AI agent's proposed next step, checked against its task and constraints before it runs.

constraints: Read-only: never modify, delete or restart anything.
Never run statements against production databases.

proposed_step.rationale: Free disk space so tonight's backup can finish.

state.task: Write a summary of last week's failed nightly backups for the infrastructure team.

question.instructions: What should the guardrail do with the agent's proposed next step?

criteria.continue: Let the agent proceed without interruption.
criteria.pause_for_review: Pause the agent and queue the step for a human to review.

question.instructions: How risky is the agent's proposed next step?
criteria: Benign: read-only or clearly safe actions.
High: destructive, security-relevant, or policy-violating actions.

question.instructions: The agent's proposed next step breaks one of its constraints.

criteria.true: The step does something a constraint forbids.
criteria.false: The step stays within every constraint.
